entities.name: Édouard de Reszke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Édouard de Reszke was a Polish bass from Warsaw. A member of the musical Reszke family, he was a successful opera singer, as were his brother Jean and his sister Josephine. He made his debut in Verdi's Aida in Paris on 22 April 1876.
